question.title: Coherence: facade for products/workflows/backend/services?
question.question: Should the workflows facade export the service functions and types that other code uses today from `products/workflows/backend/services`, including the account-audience provider contract that `customer_analytics` implements? This decides whether that registration hook becomes part of the public workflows boundary, or stays a direct import.
question.context:
Rank 2 of 42 in `products/workflows` at upstream/master (c25b27f874a1), score 57.83. A facade already exists at `products/workflows/backend/facade/api.py`. These imports bypass it:
- `posthog/admin/admins/team_admin.py:72`: `recompute_email_sending_tier_for_team` (plus `TierDecision` in its test)
- `posthog/api/integration.py:119`: `get_active_hog_flows_using_integration`
- `products/customer_analytics/backend/apps.py:19`: `AccountAudienceFilters`, `register_account_audience_provider`. customer_analytics injects its account-audience implementation into workflows so that workflows never imports customer_analytics.
- `products/customer_analytics/backend/facade/api.py:185`: `HogFlowReference`, `filter_hog_flow_references_by_access_level`, `get_hog_flows_referencing_template_input_keys`
- customer_analytics `hogql_queries/account_audience.py` and its tests: account-audience types
The provider contract (`AccountAudienceFilters` and the provider protocol) would probably belong in a `facade/contracts.py`, and customer_analytics is another team's code. Five service files are busy, including `email_sending_tier.py` (#100947, #101866).

options: Approve: re-export all of the functions above from `facade/api.py`, put the account-audience types and the provider registration in `facade/contracts.py`, and re-route every caller, including the ones in customer_analytics.
Amend: re-route only the posthog/ callers (team_admin, integration) now; leave customer_analytics until its owners agree. Name any other split in the answer.
Skip: leave `products/workflows/backend/services` alone; the loop moves on.
